title: Netherlands considering AI security agency to address serious concerns
title_zh: 荷兰正在考虑成立人工智能安全机构，以应对严重的安全问题。
description: Prime Minister Rob Jetten wants the Netherlands to follow other countries in establishing a safety institute for artificial intelligence (AI).
description_zh: 荷兰首相罗布·杰滕希望荷兰效仿其他国家，建立人工智能（AI）安全研究所。

description_zh: 荷兰电网管理协会（Netbeheer Nederland）报告称，电网容量不足以满足数十万新建住宅的电力连接申请。

title: Anti-asylum protesters pelt cops with fireworks in Gelderland town; Over 10 arrested
title_zh: 在海尔德兰省的一个小镇，反难民抗议者向警察投掷烟花；超过10人被捕
description: Anti-asylum demonstrators turned against the police and started throwing fireworks in the Gelderland town of Opheusden on Thursday evening.
description_zh: 周四晚上，在海尔德兰省奥普斯登镇，反难民示威者与警察发生冲突，并开始投掷烟花。

title: Ziggo blocks ad-skipping on commercial channels without warning customers
title_zh: Ziggo会在未事先通知客户的情况下阻止用户跳过商业频道上的广告。

description_zh: 据报道，从9月1日起，通过Ziggo观看电视的用户将无法再跳过广告时段。

title: NEC continue poor start to the season with 5-0 hammering at the hands of Juventus
title_zh: NEC本赛季开局不利，以0-5惨败于尤文图斯。
description: NEC were hammered in their first game in the main stage of European competition for 18 years, away to Juventus on Thursday.
description_zh: NEC在周四客场对阵尤文图斯的比赛中惨败，这是他们18年来首次参加欧洲赛事的主要阶段比赛。

title: Man, 20, who murdered his mother is ordered to psychiatric treatment, spared jail time
title_zh: 一名20岁男子杀害了自己的母亲，被判接受精神治疗，免于牢狱之灾。
description: The District Court in The Hague has ordered Ridvan B., 20, to undergo mandatory psychiatric treatment at a TBS facility after he murdered his 42-year-old mother at their home in April last year.
description_zh: 海牙地方法院下令，20 岁的 Ridvan B. 在去年 4 月于家中谋杀了 42 岁的母亲后，必须在 TBS 机构接受强制精神治疗。

title: Ajax's 17-year-old winger Abdellah Ouazane picked in Morocco squad for first time

description: Ajax’s 17-year-old winger Abdellah Ouazane has been called up for the Moroccan national side for the first time.
description_zh: 阿贾克斯17岁边锋阿卜杜拉·瓦扎内首次入选摩洛哥国家队。

title: Number of Dutch workers no longer growing due to aging population; Unemployment stable
title_zh: 由于人口老龄化，荷兰劳动人口数量不再增长；失业率保持稳定。
description: The number of officially unemployed people is rising, with more than 8.5 million in the Netherlands currently not in the workforce, according to Statistics Netherlands (CBS).
description_zh: 据荷兰统计局（CBS）的数据显示，官方统计的失业人数正在上升，目前荷兰有超过 850 万人不在劳动力市场中。

title: Bookings rise for trains, buses to Germany in anticipation of Oktoberfest
title_zh: 随着慕尼黑啤酒节的临近，前往德国的火车和巴士预订量激增。
description: Trains going towards Germany will be busier over the coming weeks due to Oktoberfest. FlixBus and NS International are seeing a rise in the number of bookings.
description_zh: 受慕尼黑啤酒节的影响，未来几周开往德国的列车将会更加繁忙。FlixBus 和 NS International 的预订量均有所上升。

description_zh: 在极右翼政党FvD最近一期英语播客节目中，嘉宾公开且毫不掩饰地宣扬种族主义意识形态，主持人兼FvD工作人员约翰·劳夫兰对此表示支持和鼓励。

title_zh: 被盗的AirPods耳机帮助哥伦比亚警方锁定了一名涉嫌谋杀荷兰女子的委内瑞拉嫌疑人。

title: Jetten still pushing "broad support" for budget; Will again invite opposition to talk

description_zh: 在第二天关于国家预算的议会辩论开始时，总理罗布·杰滕并未就内阁如何应对“总体政治考量”给出明确答复。

title: European Commission proposes one-hour social media screen limit for 13 to 15 year olds
title_zh: 欧盟委员会提议将13至15岁青少年使用社交媒体的时间限制在一小时以内。
description: The European Commission proposes limiting children aged 13 to 15 to one hour of screen time per day on social media, as part of plans to restrict their access to the platforms.
description_zh: 欧盟委员会提议将 13 至 15 岁儿童每天使用社交媒体的屏幕时间限制在一小时以内，作为限制他们访问这些平台计划的一部分。

title: KLM warns of far-reaching interventions to secure its future in troubling times
title_zh: 荷航警告称，在当前动荡时期，将采取影响深远的干预措施以确保其未来发展。
description: KLM is facing challenging times, and hard choices will have to be made to secure its future.
description_zh: 荷航正面临挑战，为了确保其未来，必须做出艰难的抉择。

description_zh: 周一，一名 19 岁男子因涉嫌在登霍恩 (Den Hoorn) 进行袭击和人身攻击而被捕，他还被怀疑在代尔夫特豪特 (Delftse Hout) 休闲区附近犯下多起袭击和性侵犯罪行。

title: Can a minority Cabinet work? PM Jetten will find out in second day of Budget Debate
title_zh: 少数派内阁能行吗？总理杰登将在预算辩论的第二天找到答案。
description: After a long and grueling first day of the General Political Considerations, it remains unclear how the minority Cabinet intends to secure majorities for its Budget Day plans.
description_zh: 经过漫长而艰苦的第一天一般政治考量会议后，少数派内阁打算如何确保其预算日计划获得多数支持仍然不明朗。

description_zh: 有189座“高度脆弱的建筑物”，例如养老院、医院和学校，位于野火高风险地区。

description: Defects have been found on another major highway bridge. Rijkswaterstaat found cracks in the western Suurhoff Bridge heading towards the Maasvlakte.
description_zh: 另一座主要公路桥梁也发现了缺陷。荷兰公共工程和水资源管理部（Rijkswaterstaat）在通往马斯弗拉克特（Maasvlakte）方向的西侧苏尔霍夫桥（Suurhoff Bridge）上发现了裂缝。
